summary: @servicetitan/tokens preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package advertises design tokens but its preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<bun-<platform>>.zip` to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute a bundled `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a single-line 727 KB blob using custom string-array obfuscation (rotation function `WV8StW` and alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`) so its behavior is not visible without running it. Fetching a second language runtime and using it to execute an obfuscated sibling script at `npm install` time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the fetched-runtime step deliberately moves execution outside Node-based scanning, and the executed payload's purpose is unrelated to a design-tokens package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
